correctness.rationale: For off-diagonal x=(a,b), y=(c,d), mutual zero products exclude b=c and d=a; a middle witness to xz=y exists exactly when a=c, and one to zx=y exactly when b=d. Thus F detects four distinct indices, and a diagonal unit annihilating both ways against x,y detects a fifth. Together with the thresholds at two and three, the given rank-at-most-three sentences separate all claimed classes. For m,n≥5 match the coordinate partition for the first two EF moves and, unless six distinct endpoints occur, also for the third. In the six-endpoint case reply to the disjoint new unit with (a,d), where the two previous units were (a,b),(c,d) on four distinct endpoints; the new reply is distinct, all nine products are zero, and all named-zero atoms agree. This proves stabilization beyond the finite computation. The 26 bound is sharp only within the displayed family. Independent bit-coded exact type recursion reproduced the partition through n=7 (python /workspace/independent_checks.py).
residual_risks: No conclusion for functional multiplication, an unnamed zero, or arbitrary external representatives; enumeration is only corroboration through n=7.
